abstract.para: Whenever you have created a disaster recovery medium with &rear;, test the disaster recovery process thoroughly. After having created the recovery system, test the recovery process on a test machine with identical hardware. Make sure the test machine is correctly set up and can serve as a replacement for your main machine.

warning.title: Extensive testing on identical hardware
warning.para: Thorough testing of the disaster recovery process on machines is required. Test the recovery procedure on a regular basis to ensure everything works as expected.

listitem.para: You created a recovery system on the original machine.
The recovery system is available on a bootable recovery medium.
The test machine has identical hardware to the original machine.

topic.para: Perform this procedure on the test machine:

step.para: Boot the test machine from the recovery medium.
Start the recovery installer with the -D option to enable verbose mode and debug mode:
This command performs the following steps:

listitem.para: Restores the disk layout, including partitions, file systems and mount points.
Restores the system files and user files from the backup.

step.para: After the recovery process is finished, check whether the system was successfully re-created and can serve as a replacement for your original system in the production environment.
